description: Search current published House wares, services, marketplace references, free research and public workspace information. Returns source errors explicitly; prices are not settlement proof.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching results to return. Defaults to 10, with a range of 1 to 20.

offset.description: Number of matching offers to skip. Defaults to 0. Use next_offset from the previous page when available.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match in offer names or metadata. Omit to match all offers.

name: search_offers
